doc_title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast and dividend forecast (dividend increase) for fiscal year ending March 2027
doc_title_jp: 業績予想及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 当期純利益の上方修正に伴い、配当性向40%目標に基づく

summary_en: FY3/27 period-end dividend raised to 245.00 yen/share from prior forecast of 188.00 yen/share. Increase reflects upward revision of net profit to 14.0 billion yen (from 10.7 billion yen forecast) driven by semiconductor-related product sales exceeding plan and improved operating leverage. Payout ratio target 40%.
summary_jp: FY3/27期末配当を245.00円/株に上方修正（前回188.00円）。半導体関連製品販売が想定超過し当期純利益を140億円に上方修正（前回107億円）。配当性向40%目標に基づく。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - FY3/27 - 245.00 yen/share (prior 188.00) - 40% payout target
tag_jp: 配当増配 - FY3/27 - 245.00円/株（前回188.00円） - 配当性向40%目標
